decision.explanation: The query asks for the sport associated with 'Boca Juniors'. The source documents distinguish between two distinct entities sharing the name: 1) 'Boca Juniors (basketball)' in Argentina, explicitly described as a basketball section (D1S1), and 2) 'Boca Juniors de Cali' in Colombia, described as a professional football team (D2S1). While the original card for D2 refers specifically to 'Boca Juniors de Cali', the entity name 'Boca Juniors' is used in the title of the first document (D1S1) to denote the basketball section. Since the prompt allows for distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers, both 'basketball' (from the Argentine club's section) and 'football' (from the Colombian team named Boca Juniors de Cali, which adopted the jersey of the Argentine team) are valid associations found in the text. The fallible audit J_A incorrectly marked 'football' as a wrong argument by assuming a single referent, whereas the text supports multiple referents.
